contract: docs/GATE-CONTRACT.md [GC-A27] NN18: warm --to check and each fixed setup stage stay inside the host's budget. A null budget FAILS NN18 on that host ("no budget measured"), it never passes. A budget is only ever lowered, and only from a new measured run.
method: Mac: three sessions of the runner's S2 step (`gate-acceptance.mjs --steps S2 --gate checkout-gate.sh`) against /Volumes/D/claude/rk-witness-fixture at 654e8b663404 on 2026-11-05, each session = two warm --to check and two warm --to compile runs with the spawn ledger on. Per session the worst of its runs is taken (warmCheckMs: the slower check run; each stage: the largest value over its four runs); the budget is the median of the three sessions times 1.25 (median x 1.25), rounded up to a millisecond.

stageLines.dependencyStep: that plan line -> the first `snapshot dependencies root=` line
